entities.summary: Hristo Boytchev is a Bulgarian writer born on March 5, 1950. The Colonel Bird won the British Council Award for Central and Eastern Europe, and was later adapted into a film, Voenno Poleva Bolnitza. He is regarded as one of Bulgaria's leading playwrights.
